name: Iron Radiance
look: a robot Ho-Oh with a scarlet armoured head under golden curls, a glowing gold-to-peach belly, scarlet wing arms trailing sheets of glowing orange-to-gold feathers and a fan of glowing gold tail feathers
entry: A Pokémon resembling Ho-Oh, pictured in a dubious magazine story about a satellite that came down to roost on a mountain. The light from its wings is said to be bright enough to see from space.
how: Wild: very rare by day on mountain peaks and highlands.
